headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 16, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a thrilling 4-3 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Jordan Hicks earning the win after 1.2 scoreless innings of relief. Eduardo Valencia led the White Sox offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs. The St. Louis Cardinals also secured a win, taking down the Chicago Cubs 8-4 behind Michael McGreevy's 6.0 innings of work.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. Vladimir Guerrero Jr. of the Toronto Blue Jays is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers is on the 15-day injured list with a right forearm flexor strain.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash. Ornelas joins the Brewers' roster, adding depth to the team's infield.

top_news.title: Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Michael McGreevy earning the win after 6.0 innings of work.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees suffered a 4-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the Yankees' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Fall to Giants in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Colorado Rockies, winning 7-1 behind a strong performance from Logan Webb. Webb pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury occurred on August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have acquired shortstop Jonathan Ornelas in a trade with the Athletics for cash. Ornelas joins the Brewers' roster, adding depth to the team's infield.
